entries.2f3b7a39de093dec: This business manufactures and sells steel products, such as rebar for civil engineering and construction, in Vietnam, the United States and Canada. External revenue from outside customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥178,988 million, and this is the largest business among the three reportable segments.
entries.3bacb29ac185d1b4: This business melts iron scrap in electric arc furnaces to make and sell steel products for civil engineering and construction. It also engages in the purchase and resale of steel products, rebar processing, and transportation. External revenue from outside customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥125,527 million.
entries.659b0c8d41475346: This business is engaged in intermediate and final treatment of medical and industrial waste, and recycled crushed stone. It has a system under which dedicated containers are collected from contracted medical institutions and melted in electric arc furnaces to render them harmless. External revenue from outside customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,945 million.
entries.cb361a4d8f36406a: This category is not included in the reportable segments and consists of the port business, casting business, insurance agency business, and others. External revenue from outside customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,646 million.
entries.cdccfe851dd5153c: A steel manufacturer that melts iron scrap in electric furnaces to make construction rebar and other products, operating in Japan, Vietnam, and North America.
